most_similar_reason: Candidate 6 matches the target most closely because divine beings are explicitly sent by a high god to bring civilization to a needy humanity, they teach the arts of living (building, crafts, customs), they are paired with primeval founder-rulers from whom later kings descend, and they found a great city with a temple — the same culture-bringer-plus-founding-of-cities sequence as the seven sages.
least_similar_reason: Candidate 1 is least similar because it concerns a creator's cyclical struggle with personified Death, resurrection, and animal emblems, with no sages, no teaching of civilization to humans, no flood-era kings, and no founding of cities.
